2607.14390.title: Why Git Is the Memory Solution for the Agentic Development Lifecycle
2607.14390.paper_summary: Coding agents now produce a growing share of a team's code, while the reasoning behind each change -- the alternatives weighed, the constraints discovered, the approaches rejected -- is trapped in assistant transcripts that vanish with the session. Memory for this setting, the agentic development lifecycle (ADLC), is usually posed as one retrieval problem and built as machinery: tiered stores, memory graphs, compiled wikis, model-judged admission. We argue memory should instead be git-bound -- built into the repository's version control, inheriting the guarantees the machinery struggles to construct: ground truth from commits, freshness from rebuild, verification from the merge, containment from review. On this ledger we solve two problems separately, then combine them. Seed supply is closed as an eight-corpus retrieval study under a pre-registered ship discipline: five imported ranking mechanisms rejected, two kept, and a best configuration of ~0.31 pooled MRR -- ~60x the raw-transcript grep floor, ~15x an honest parsed-turn floor. Answer assembly is where ranking stops helping: single-shot retrieval scores only 0.07-0.20 answer-sufficiency on real developer questions, and ungated episode injection measurably degrades good answers. A router dispatches breadth to a git-anchored structural map, pointed lookups to confidence-gated episodes, and rationale to decision synthesis, which reconstructs why-arcs no single session contains (0.83 sufficiency on a young ~50k-LOC production system). Routed, the system answers at 382-980 tokens per question -- three orders of magnitude below the recorded history. Because ground truth is mined from commit-session links rather than annotated, every result is replicable on any user's own history at zero labeling cost. The remaining constraint is capture. Code, benchmark, and paper source: github.com/rekal-dev/rekal-cli.
2607.14390.paper_summary_zh: 編碼代理現在產生了團隊代碼中日益增長的一部分，而每次更改背後的推理——權衡的替代方案、發現的約束、被拒絕的方法——則被困在隨著會話消失的助手記錄中。這種設置的記憶，即代理開發生命周期（ADLC），通常被視為一個檢索問題並構建為機械裝置：分層存儲、記憶圖、編譯的維基、模型判斷的入場。我們主張記憶應該是與git綁定的——內嵌於版本控制的庫中，繼承機械裝置努力構建的保證：來自提交的真實基礎、來自重建的新鮮度、來自合併的驗證、來自審查的封閉。在這個帳本上，我們分別解決兩個問題，然後將它們結合起來。種子供應作為一個八語料庫檢索研究在預註冊的船舶紀律下結束：五個導入的排名機制被拒絕，兩個保留，最佳配置的~0.31合併平均回報率——約60倍於原始記錄的grep底線，約15倍於誠實解析回合的底線。答案組裝是排名停止幫助的地方：單次檢索在真實開發者問題上的答案充分性得分僅為0.07-0.20，而無門檻的事件注入明顯降低了良好答案的質量。一個路由器將廣度分派到一個以git為基礎的結構圖，將指向查找分派到信心門檻的事件，並將推理分派到決策合成，該合成重建了沒有單一會話所包含的原因弧（在一個年輕的約50k-LOC生產系統上達到0.83的充分性）。經過路由，系統每個問題回答的令牌數在382-980之間——比記錄歷史低三個數量級。因為真實基礎是從提交會話鏈中挖掘出來的，而不是註釋的，所以每個結果在任何用戶自己的歷史上都是可重複的，且零標註成本。剩下的約束是捕獲。代碼、基準和論文來源：github.com/rekal-dev/rekal-cli。
